title: Host a Neighbourhood Cleanup Party
organiser: City of Vancouver Neighbourhood Cleanup Programs
whatToBring: The City can provide cleanup supplies for registered events.

title: Adopt a Block
whatToBring: Commit to cleaning an adopted block at least once a month for one year.

title: Adopt a Catch Basin
whatToBring: Keep a nearby catch basin clear of leaves and debris, especially before rain.

title: Become a Park Steward
organiser: Vancouver Board of Parks and Recreation
whatToBring: Park Board staff provide training, tools, and plants for stewardship activities.

title: Volunteer with Green Streets
whatToBring: Help care for a traffic-calming garden in your neighbourhood.
